description: Table elements - React Native has no native table support
reason: React Native does not have table elements - use FlatList or custom grid layouts

alternatives.table: FlatList with custom row rendering or View with flexbox grid
alternatives.caption: Text component above the data list
alternatives.thead: Header component or sticky header in FlatList
alternatives.tbody: FlatList data prop or View containing rows
alternatives.tfoot: Footer component or ListFooterComponent in FlatList
alternatives.tr: View with flexDirection: 'row' for table row
alternatives.td: View with flex: 1 containing Text for table cell
alternatives.th: View with header styling containing Text
alternatives.colgroup: No direct equivalent - handle column styling per cell
alternatives.col: No direct equivalent - handle column styling per cell
